events.description: This event is triggered when client\-side debug messages (for instance errors or warnings) would appear in the debug window. This event doesn't require the debug window to be enabled to trigger, however.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message which was outputted in the server console, without details like file, line etc

parameters.name: level
parameters.description:
The type of debug message which was outputted
0: "Custom" message
1: Error message
2: Warning message
3: Information message

parameters.name: file
parameters.description:
The file from which the debug message was outputted
Note: May return nil when the source could not be found

parameters.name: line
parameters.description:
The line in file file where the debug message was outputted
Note: May return nil when the source could not be found

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Amount of red color (0-255)

parameters.name: g
parameters.description: Amount of green color (0-255)

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Amount of blue color (0-255)

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the root element.

events.name: onClientDoubleClick
events.description: This event triggers whenever the user double\-clicks his mouse. This is linked to the GTA world, as appose to GUI for which [onClientGUIDoubleClick](/wiki/OnClientGUIDoubleClick "OnClientGUIDoubleClick") is to be used. This event allows detection of click positions of the 3D world.

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: This refers the button used to click on the mouse, can be left, right, or middle.

parameters.name: absoluteX
parameters.description: This refers to the 2D x coordinate the user clicked on his screen, and is an absolute position in pixels.

parameters.name: absoluteY
parameters.description: This refers to the 2D y coordinate the user clicked on his screen, and is an absolute position in pixels.

parameters.name: worldX
parameters.description: This represents the 3D x coordinate the player clicked on the screen, and is relative to the GTA world.

parameters.name: worldY
parameters.description: This represents the 3D y coordinate the player clicked on the screen, and is relative to the GTA world.

parameters.name: worldZ
parameters.description: This represents the 3D z coordinate the player clicked on the screen, and is relative to the GTA world.

parameters.name: clickedWorld
parameters.description: This represents any physical entity elements that were clicked. If the player clicked on no MTA element, it's set to false.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the client's root element.

events.name: onClientElementColShapeHit
events.description: This event is triggered when an element (like a player or vehicle) enters a collision shape.

parameters.name: theShape
parameters.description: the colshape that the element entered.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: true if the element is in the same dimension as the colshape, false otherwise.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that entered the colshape.

events.name: onClientElementColShapeLeave
events.description: This event is triggered when an element (like a player or vehicle) leaves a collision shape.

parameters.name: theShape
parameters.description: the colshape that the element left.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: true if the element is in the same dimension as the colshape, false otherwise.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that left the colshape.

events.name: onClientElementDataChange
events.description: This event is triggered *after* an element's [data](/wiki/Element_data "Element data") entry is changed. Such changes can be made on the client or the server using [setElementData](/wiki/SetElementData "SetElementData").

parameters.name: theKey
parameters.description: The name of the element data entry that has changed.

parameters.name: oldValue
parameters.description: The old value of this entry before it changed. See element data for a list of possible datatypes.

parameters.name: newValue
parameters.description: the new value of this entry after it changed. This will be equivalent to getElementData(source, theKey).

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element whose element data changed.

events.name: onClientElementDestroy
events.description: This event is triggered when an element gets destroyed by [destroyElement](/wiki/DestroyElement "DestroyElement") or when the creator resource is stopping. It is also triggered when a children element of this element is destroyed. It is not triggered on a player when they quit.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that is being destroyed.

events.name: onClientElementDimensionChange
events.description: This event is triggered when the dimension of an [element](/wiki/Element "Element") is changed using [setElementDimension](/wiki/SetElementDimension "SetElementDimension").

parameters.name: oldDimension
parameters.description: An int representing the dimension the element was in before.

parameters.name: newDimension
parameters.description: An int representing the dimension the element is in now.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that changed its dimension.

events.name: onClientElementInteriorChange
events.description: This event is triggered when the interior of an [element](/wiki/Element "Element") is changed using [setElementInterior](/wiki/SetElementInterior "SetElementInterior").

parameters.name: oldInterior
parameters.description: An int representing the interior the element was in before.

parameters.name: newInterior
parameters.description: An int representing the interior the element is in now.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that changed its interior.

events.name: onClientElementModelChange
events.description: This event is triggered when the model of an [element](/wiki/Element "Element") is changed using [setElementModel](/wiki/SetElementModel "SetElementModel").

parameters.name: oldModel
parameters.description: an int representing the model of the element before the change occurred.

parameters.name: newModel
parameters.description: an int representing the new model of the element.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that changed its model.

events.canceling: This event doesn't support cancellation. Use setElementModel with the old value to reverse.

events.name: onClientElementStreamIn
events.description: This event is triggered whenever a physical element is streamed in. This is triggered for all elements that are streamable, such as players, peds, vehicles, objects and markers. When this event is triggered, that element is guaranteed to be physically created as a GTA object.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that streamed in.

events.name: onClientElementStreamOut
events.description: This event is triggered whenever a physical element is streamed out. This is triggered for all elements that are streamable, such as players, peds, vehicles, objects and markers when the local player is leaving the element. When this event is triggered, that element is no longer physical and is now virtualized by MTA.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that streamed out.

events.name: onClientExplosion
events.description: This event is triggered every time an explosion is created on the current **clients scene** (inside the streamer).

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X coordinate of where the explosion was created

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y coordinate of where the explosion was created

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: Z coordinate of where the explosion was created

parameters.name: theType
parameters.description: the type of explosion created, see: Explosion types

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player who created the explosion. If the explosion is from a vehicle the source is the player who syncs the vehicle.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the explosion will not occur.

events.name: onClientFileDownloadComplete
events.description: This event is triggered when a file has been downloaded after [downloadFile](/wiki/DownloadFile "DownloadFile") has been successfully called.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: the file downloaded.

parameters.name: success
parameters.description: whether successful or not.

parameters.name: requestResource
parameters.description: the resource that called downloadFile.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the root element of the resource that downloaded file.

events.name: onClientGUIAccepted
events.description: This event is triggered when enter is pressed on an editbox.

parameters.name: editBox
parameters.description: the editbox which had focus.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the editbox which enter was pressed on.

events.name: onClientGUIBlur
events.description: This event is triggered each time a GUI element looses input focus (mainly useful for windows, editboxes and memos but triggered for all GUI elements nevertheless).

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element which just lost input focus.

events.name: onClientGUIChanged
events.description: This event is fired when a [memo](/wiki/Element/GUI/Memo "Element/GUI/Memo") or an [editbox](/wiki/Element/GUI/Edit_field "Element/GUI/Edit field") has changed (either by the user or by [guiSetText](/wiki/GuiSetText "GuiSetText")).

parameters.name: theElement
parameters.description: The GUI element which was changed.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element which was changed.

events.name: onClientGUIClick
events.description: This event happens when any gui\-element clicked.

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: the name of the button which will be clicked, it can be left, right, middle.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: the state of the mouse button, will be down if the mouse button was pushed, or up if it was released. Please note currently only the up state is supported.

parameters.name: absoluteX
parameters.description: the X position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the left side of the screen.

parameters.name: absoluteY
parameters.description: the Y position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the top of the screen.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element that was clicked.

events.name: onClientGUIComboBoxAccepted
events.description: This event is called when a [combobox](/wiki/Element/GUI/Combobox "Element/GUI/Combobox") gets accepted.

parameters.name: theElement
parameters.description: the combobox that got accepted.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI combo box that was accepted.

events.name: onClientGUIDoubleClick
events.description: This event is fired when the user double clicks a GUI element. Doesn't work with buttons.

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: the name of the mouse button that the GUI element was double clicked with.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: the state of the mouse button. Can be down or up. Please note currently only the up state is supported.

parameters.name: absoluteX
parameters.description: the X position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the left side of the screen.

parameters.name: absoluteY
parameters.description: the Y position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the top of the screen.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element that was double clicked.

events.name: onClientGUIFocus
events.description: This event is triggered each time a GUI element gains input focus (mainly useful for windows, editboxes and memos but triggered for all GUI elements nevertheless).

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element which just gained input focus.

events.name: onClientGUIMouseDown
events.description: This event is fired when the user clicks certain mouse button on a GUI element.

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: the name of the mouse button that the GUI element was clicked with, can be left, right, or middle.

parameters.name: absoluteX
parameters.description: the X position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the left side of the screen.

parameters.name: absoluteY
parameters.description: the Y position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the top of the screen.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element that was clicked.

events.name: onClientGUIMouseUp
events.description: This event is fired when the user releases his mouse button when on top of a GUI element.

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: the name of the mouse button that was released on a GUI element, can be left, right, or middle.

parameters.name: absoluteX
parameters.description: the X position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the left side of the screen.

parameters.name: absoluteY
parameters.description: the Y position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the top of the screen.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element on top of which the mouse button was released.

events.name: onClientGUIMove
events.description: This event is triggered each time the user moves a GUI element.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element which was moved.

events.name: onClientGUIScroll
events.description: This event is fired when a GUI scrollbar is scrolled.

parameters.name: scrolled
parameters.description: the scrollbar element that was scrolled.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the scrollbar element that got scrolled.

events.name: onClientGUISize
events.description: This event is triggered when the local client resizes a GUI element.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element that was resized.

events.name: onClientGUITabSwitched
events.description: This event is triggered each time the user switch from GUI tab.

parameters.name: theElement
parameters.description: the tab which was selected.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the tab.

events.name: onClientHUDRender
events.description: This event is triggered before GTA renders the HUD. This is particularly useful if you want to use [dxUpdateScreenSource](/wiki/DxUpdateScreenSource "DxUpdateScreenSource") to capture the screen onto a texture without capturing the HUD, or to alter HUD textures using [shaders](/wiki/Element/Shader "Element/Shader") before they are drawn onto the screen.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the client's root element.

events.name: onClientKey
events.description:
This event triggers whenever the user presses a button on their keyboard or mouse.
This event can also be used to see if the client scrolls their mouse wheel.

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: This refers the button pressed. See key names for a list of keys.

parameters.name: pressOrRelease
parameters.description: This refers to whether they were pressing or releasing the key, true when pressing, false when releasing.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the client's root element.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, then all GTA and MTA binds, bound to the canceled key, won't be triggered.

events.name: onClientMarkerHit
events.description: This event is triggered when a player enters a marker created using [createMarker](/wiki/CreateMarker "CreateMarker").

parameters.name: hitPlayer
parameters.description: the player that hit the marker.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: true if the player is in the same dimension as the hit marker.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the marker that got hit by the player.

events.name: onClientMarkerLeave
events.description: This event is triggered when a player leaves the area of a marker created using [createMarker](/wiki/CreateMarker "CreateMarker").

parameters.name: leftPlayer
parameters.description: the player that left the marker's area.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: true if the player is in the same dimension as the marker.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the marker that the player left.

events.name: onClientMinimize
events.description: This event is triggered when the local player minimizes the game screen.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is root element.

events.name: onClientMouseEnter
events.description: This event is fired when the user moves the mouse over a GUI element.

parameters.name: absoluteX
parameters.description: the X position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the left side of the screen.

parameters.name: absoluteY
parameters.description: the Y position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the top of the screen.

parameters.name: leftGUI
parameters.description: the gui element that was switched from, or nil if it doesn't exist.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element that was pointed at.

events.name: onClientMouseLeave
events.description: This event is fired when the user moves the mouse away from a GUI element.

parameters.name: absoluteX
parameters.description: the X position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the left side of the screen.

parameters.name: absoluteY
parameters.description: the Y position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the top of the screen.

parameters.name: enteredGUI
parameters.description: is the GUI element that was switched from, or nil if it doesn't exist.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element that the mouse was moved from.

events.name: onClientMouseMove
events.description: This event is triggered each time the user moves the mouse on top of a GUI element.

parameters.name: absoluteX
parameters.description: the X position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the left side of the screen.

parameters.name: absoluteY
parameters.description: the Y position of the mouse cursor, in pixels, measured from the top of the screen.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element on which the mouse was moved.

events.name: onClientMouseWheel
events.description: This event is triggered each time the user scrolls his mouse scroll on top of a GUI element.

parameters.name: upOrDown
parameters.description: An integer representing whether the scroll was scrolled up or down. This can be either 1 (mouse was scrolled up) or -1 (mouse was scrolled down).

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the GUI element on which the mouse scroll was scrolled.

events.name: onClientMTAFocusChange
events.description: This event is triggered every time the MTA window gains or loses focus.

parameters.name: windowFocused
parameters.description: A boolean, indicating whether the MTA window is focused or not.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the root element.

events.name: onClientObjectBreak
events.description: This event is fired before an object breaks.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: the vehicle/ped/player who is breaking the object

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the object which will break.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the object will not break.

events.name: onClientObjectDamage
events.description: This event is fired before an object gets damaged.

parameters.name: loss
parameters.description: the health loss caused by the damage. This parameter contains the theoretical loss, which could be less than 0, if you substract it of the current health. If you want to get the real loss, you have to substract the new health of the old health (use a timer for this).

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: the vehicle/ped/player who is damaging the object.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the object which was damaged.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the object will not be damaged.

events.name: onClientObjectMoveStart
events.description: This event is triggered when an [object](/wiki/Object "Object") starts moving.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the object which was moved.

events.name: onClientObjectMoveStop
events.description: This event is triggered when an [object](/wiki/Object "Object")'s movements stop.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the object which was moved.

events.name: onClientPaste
events.description: This event triggers when user paste whatever (**CTRL \+ V**). **This event isn't triggered if menu or console is visible or if any browser is focused, or if cursor is invisible.**

parameters.name: clipboardText
parameters.description: a string representing the pasted value from clipboard.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the client's root element.

events.name: onClientPedChoke
events.description: This event is fired when a ped chokes due to the effect of a weapon such as tear gas grenades, fire extinguishers and spray cans.

parameters.name: weaponID
parameters.description: an int representing the ID of the weapon which caused the choking.

parameters.name: responsiblePed
parameters.description: the ped responsible for causing the choking, possiblly nil.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the ped who is choking.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the ped will not be choked.

events.name: onClientPedDamage
events.description: This event is triggered whenever a [ped](/wiki/Ped "Ped") is damaged.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: A player element representing the attacker or vehicle element (when a ped falls of a bike).

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: An integer representing the weapon ID the attacker used

parameters.name: bodypart
parameters.description:
An integer representing the bodypart the ped was damaged
3: Torso
4: Ass
5: Left Arm
6: Right Arm
7: Left Leg
8: Right Leg
9: Head

parameters.name: loss
parameters.description: A float representing the percentage of health the ped lost.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the ped that got damaged

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, then any damaging effects to the ped will cease.

events.name: onClientPedHeliKilled
events.description: This event is fired when a ped is killed due to the effect of a helicopter blades.

parameters.name: killer
parameters.description: the vehicle (heli) responsible for causing the death.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the ped who was killed

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the ped will not be killed

events.name: onClientPedHitByWaterCannon
events.description: This event is fired when a ped is hit by a water cannon.

parameters.name: pedHit
parameters.description: the ped which got shot by the water cannon

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle who shot the water cannon.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the ped will not be knocked down

events.name: onClientPedsProcessed
events.description: This event is triggered after GTA updates bone transformations for all peds. This event can be used for updating bones.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the client's root element.

events.name: onClientPedStep
events.description: This event is called when a peds foot has come on to the ground after jumping or taking a full step.

parameters.name: leftFoot
parameters.description: a bool representing if it was the left foot that moved.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the ped who stepped.

events.name: onClientPedVehicleEnter
events.description: This event is fired when a [ped](/wiki/Ped "Ped") has entered a [vehicle](/wiki/Vehicle "Vehicle").

parameters.name: theVehicle
parameters.description: The vehicle that the ped entered.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: The seat that the ped now is on. Driver's seat = 0, higher numbers are passenger seats.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the ped that entered the vehicle.

events.name: onClientPedVehicleExit
events.description: This event is fired when a [ped](/wiki/Ped "Ped") has exited a [vehicle](/wiki/Vehicle "Vehicle").

parameters.name: theVehicle
parameters.description: The vehicle that the ped exited.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: The number of the seat that the ped was sitting on.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the ped that exited the vehicle.

events.name: onClientPedWasted
events.description: This event is triggered whenever a ped dies.

parameters.name: killer
parameters.description: A player, ped or vehicle element representing the killer.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: An integer representing the killer weapon or the damage types.

parameters.name: bodypart
parameters.description:
An integer representing the bodypart the player was damaged.
3: Torso
4: Ass
5: Left Arm
6: Right Arm
7: Left Leg
8: Right Leg
9: Head

parameters.name: lossOrStealth
parameters.description: A float representing the percentage of health the ped lost in the final "hit" (only for client-side created peds.) or a boolean representing whether or not this was a stealth kill

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the ped that died.

events.name: onClientPedWeaponFire
events.description: This event is called when ped shoots a weapon. This does not trigger for projectiles based, or melee weapons.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: an int representing weapon used for making a shot.

parameters.name: ammo
parameters.description: an int ammount of ammo left for this weapon type.

parameters.name: ammoInClip
parameters.description: an int ammount of ammo left for this weapon type in clip.

parameters.name: hitX
parameters.description: float world X coordinate representing the hit point.

parameters.name: hitY
parameters.description: float world Y coordinate representing the hit point.

parameters.name: hitZ
parameters.description: float world Z coordinate representing the hit point.

parameters.name: hitElement
parameters.description: an element which was hit by a shot.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the ped who fired the weapon.

events.name: onClientPickupHit
events.description: This event triggers whenever a pickup is hit clientside.

parameters.name: thePlayer
parameters.description: the player that hit the pickup

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: true if thePlayer is in the same dimension as the pickup, false otherwise.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the pickup that was hit.

events.name: onClientPickupLeave
events.description: This event triggers whenever a pickup is left clientside.

parameters.name: thePlayer
parameters.description: the player that left the pickup

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: true if thePlayer is in the same dimension as the pickup, false otherwise.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the pickup that was left.

events.name: onClientPlayerChangeNick
events.description: This event is triggered when a player changes his nickname.

parameters.name: oldNick
parameters.description: the nickname the player had before.

parameters.name: newNick
parameters.description: the new nickname of the player.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that changed his nick

events.name: onClientPlayerChoke
events.description: This event is fired when the local player chokes due to the effect of a weapon such as tear gas grenades, fire extinguishers and spray cans.

parameters.name: weaponID
parameters.description: an int representing the ID of the weapon which caused the choking.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player who is choking. (Local player only)

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the player will not be choked.

events.name: onClientPlayerDamage
events.description: This event is triggered whenever a player is damaged.

parameters.name: attacker
parameters.description: A player element representing the attacker or vehicle element (when being run over or falling off a bike).

parameters.name: damage_causing
parameters.description: An int representing the cause of damage, either a attacker weapon, or some other types of damage.

parameters.name: bodypart
parameters.description:
An integer representing the bodypart the player was damaged.
3: Torso
4: Ass
5: Left Arm
6: Right Arm
7: Left Leg
8: Right Leg
9: Head

parameters.name: loss
parameters.description: A float representing the percentage of health the player lost.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that got damaged. (Streamed in players only)

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, then any damaging effects to the local player will cease.

events.name: onClientPlayerHeliKilled
events.description: This event is fired when a player is killed due to the effect of a helicopter blades.

parameters.name: killer
parameters.description: the vehicle (heli) responsible for causing the death.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player who was killed

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the player will not be killed

events.name: onClientPlayerHitByWaterCannon
events.description: This event is fired when a player is hit by a water cannon.

parameters.name: playerHit
parameters.description: the player which got shot by the water cannon

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle who shot the water cannon.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the player will not be knocked down.

events.name: onClientPlayerJoin
events.description: This event is triggered when a [player](/wiki/Player "Player") joins a server. It is triggered for all players except the local player, as the local player joins the server before their client\-side resources are started. It would also be possible for two players to join within a few seconds of each other and for the two players' scripts may not receive onClientPlayerJoin events as their scripts wouldn't have started yet.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that joined the server.

events.name: onClientPlayerNetworkStatus
events.description: This event is triggered when the server network connection to a player is interrupted. See [onPlayerNetworkStatus](/wiki/OnPlayerNetworkStatus "OnPlayerNetworkStatus") for detecting player to server interruptions.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: A number which is 0 if the interruption has begun, or 1 if the interruption is ending.

parameters.name: ticks
parameters.description: Number of ticks since the interruption started.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the root element.

events.name: onClientPlayerPickupHit
events.description: This event triggers whenever a player hits a pickup locally.

parameters.name: thePickup
parameters.description: the pickup that was hit.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: true if thePickup is in the same dimension as the player, false otherwise.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that hit the pickup.

events.name: onClientPlayerPickupLeave
events.description: This event triggers whenever a player leaves pickup locally.

parameters.name: thePickup
parameters.description: the pickup that was left.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: true if thePickup is in the same dimension as the player, false otherwise.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that left the pickup.

events.name: onClientPlayerQuit
events.description: This event is triggered when a **remote** player quits the game or leaves the server. It **will not** get triggered on the source player's client. (Use [onClientResourceStop](/wiki/OnClientResourceStop "OnClientResourceStop") to save client side data when the local player quits.)

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description:
A string representing the reason why the player quit.
"Unknown"
"Quit"
"Kicked"
"Banned"
"Bad Connection"
"Timed out"

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that quit the game.

events.name: onClientPlayerRadioSwitch
events.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player's radio station is changed

parameters.name: stationID
parameters.description: An integer representing the station the player switched to.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the local player.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the Radio station will not change.

events.name: onClientPlayerSpawn
events.description: This event is triggered when any player, including a remote player, spawns.

parameters.name: hisTeam
parameters.description: A team element representing the team the player spawned on.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that spawned.

events.name: onClientPlayerStealthKill
events.description: This event is triggered when the local player stealth kills another player.

parameters.name: targetPlayer
parameters.description: The player or ped that is being stealth killed.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that initiated the stealth kill. (Local player only)

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, then the stealth kill is aborted.

events.name: onClientPlayerStuntFinish
events.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player finishes a vehicle stunt.

parameters.name: stuntType
parameters.description:
the type of stunt the player just performed. Valid types are:
2wheeler
wheelie
stoppie

parameters.name: stuntTime
parameters.description: the number of miliseconds the stunt lasted.

parameters.name: stuntDistance
parameters.description: the distance traveled while doing the stunt.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the local player.

events.name: onClientPlayerStuntStart
events.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player starts doing a vehicle stunt.

parameters.name: stuntType
parameters.description:
the type of stunt the player is starting to perform. Valid types are:
2wheeler
wheelie
stoppie

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the local player.

events.name: onClientPlayerTarget
events.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player targets an element.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The element the player targetted.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that targeted the element.

events.name: onClientPlayerVehicleEnter
events.description: This event is fired when a player has entered a vehicle.

parameters.name: theVehicle
parameters.description: the vehicle that the player entered

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: the seat that the player now is on. Driver's seat = 0, higher numbers are passenger seats.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that entered the vehicle.

events.name: onClientPlayerVehicleExit
events.description: This event is triggered when a player has exited a vehicle.

parameters.name: theVehicle
parameters.description: the vehicle that the player exited.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: the number of the seat that the player was sitting on.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that exited the vehicle.

events.name: onClientPlayerVoicePause
events.description: This event is triggered when a player's voice sound is paused using [setSoundPaused](/wiki/SetSoundPaused "SetSoundPaused").

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason for the pause, this can be only "paused".

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player whose voice got paused.

events.name: onClientPlayerVoiceResumed
events.description: This event is triggered when a player's voice sound is resumed using [setSoundPaused](/wiki/SetSoundPaused "SetSoundPaused").

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason for the pause, this can be only "resumed".

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player whose voice got resumed.

events.name: onClientPlayerVoiceStart
events.description: This event is triggered when a player starts talking through voice chat.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player element that just started talking through voice chat.

events.canceling: This example outputs to the console the player that started talking.

events.name: onClientPlayerVoiceStop
events.description: This event is triggered when a player stops talking through voice chat.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player element that just stopped talking through voice chat.

events.canceling: This example outputs to the console the player that stopped talking.

events.name: onClientPlayerWasted
events.description: This event is triggered whenever a player, including those remote, dies.

parameters.name: killer
parameters.description: A player, ped or vehicle element representing the killer.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: An integer representing the killer weapon or the damage types.

parameters.name: bodypart
parameters.description:
An integer representing the bodypart the player was damaged.
3: Torso
4: Ass
5: Left Arm
6: Right Arm
7: Left Leg
8: Right Leg
9: Head

parameters.name: stealth
parameters.description: A boolean representing whether or not this was a stealth kill.

parameters.name: animGroup
parameters.description: an integer representing the player's current animation group.

parameters.name: animID
parameters.description: an integer representing the player's current animation ID.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that died.

events.name: onClientPlayerWeaponFire
events.description: This event is called when a player fires a weapon. This event does not trigger for melee weapons. Projectile weapons or the camera will only trigger the event if fired by the local player.

parameters.name: weapon
parameters.description: an int representing weapon used for firing a shot.

parameters.name: ammo
parameters.description: an int amount of ammo left for this weapon type.

parameters.name: ammoInClip
parameters.description: an int amount of ammo left for this weapon type in clip.

parameters.name: hitX
parameters.description: float world X coordinate representing the hit point.

parameters.name: hitY
parameters.description: float world Y coordinate representing the hit point.

parameters.name: hitZ
parameters.description: float world Z coordinate representing the hit point.

parameters.name: hitElement
parameters.description: an element which was hit by a shot.

parameters.name: startX
parameters.description: float world X coordinate representing the start of the bullet. Note: This is not the gun muzzle.

parameters.name: startY
parameters.description: float world Y coordinate representing the start of the bullet.

parameters.name: startZ
parameters.description: float world Z coordinate representing the start of the bullet.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the streamed in player who fired the weapon.

events.name: onClientPlayerWeaponSwitch
events.description: This event is triggered whenever the local player's equipped **[weapon slot](/wiki/Weapon "Weapon")** changes. This means giveWeapon and takeWeapon will trigger this event if the equipped slot is forced to change.

parameters.name: previousWeaponSlot
parameters.description: An integer representing the previous weapon slot the player had before he switched.

parameters.name: currentWeaponSlot
parameters.description: An integer representing the new weapon slot the player has after he switched.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player who switched their weapon (Local player only)

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, then the weapon will not be switched.

events.name: onClientPreRender
events.description: This event is triggered every time before GTA renders a new frame.

parameters.name: timeSlice
parameters.description: The interval between this frame and the previous one in milliseconds (delta time).

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the client's root element.

events.name: onClientProjectileCreation
events.description: This event is triggered when a [projectile](/wiki/Projectile "Projectile") is created.

parameters.name: creator
parameters.description: the element that created the projectile.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the projectile that was created.

events.canceling: This event cannot be cancelled. To remove the projectile you can use setElementPosition (somewhere far away) and then destroyElement (which makes it explode).

events.name: onClientRender
events.description: This event is triggered every time GTA renders a new frame. It is required for the DirectX drawing functions, and also useful for other clientside operations that have to be applied repeatedly with very short time differences between them.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the client's root element.

events.name: onClientResourceFileDownload
events.description: This event is triggered every time a [resource](/wiki/Resource "Resource") file download is queued, finished or has failed.

parameters.name: fileResource
parameters.description: Resource the file belongs to.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Relative resource file path.

parameters.name: fileSize
parameters.description: Size of the file in bytes.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Possible values: "queued" or "finished" or "failed".

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the resource's root element.

events.name: onClientResourceStart
events.description: This event is triggered when a [resource](/wiki/Resource "Resource") is started. Please note that this is **not** triggered the same time as the serverside event [onResourceStart](/wiki/OnResourceStart "OnResourceStart") is. The event is triggered when any *clientside resources* are started. This means it is triggered when a clientside script is initiated after a download, which includes downloading after join. So:

parameters.name: startedResource
parameters.description: the resource that was started.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the started resource's root element.

events.name: onClientResourceStop
events.description: This event is triggered when a [resource](/wiki/Resource "Resource") is being stopped.

parameters.name: stoppedResource
parameters.description: the resource that is about to get stopped.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the stopped resource root element.

events.name: onClientRestore
events.description: This event is triggered when the local player restores the game screen from a previously minimized state.

parameters.name: didClearRenderTargets
parameters.description: A bool specifying whether all render targets have been cleared as part of the restore process. Generally, restoring in full screen mode will clear render targets.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is root element.

events.name: onClientSoundBeat
events.description: This event is triggered when a **sound** beats.

parameters.name: theTime
parameters.description: the position in the song of the beat

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the sound's element.

events.name: onClientSoundChangedMeta
events.description: This event is triggered when a sound's meta tags have been modified.

parameters.name: streamTitle
parameters.description: The title of a specific stream

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the sound of which the meta tags have just been modified.

events.name: onClientSoundFinishedDownload
events.description: This event is triggered when a sound has just finished downloading. This means the complete sound file is now loaded in the player's RAM, and can be played completely from start to end. Unlike [onClientSoundStream](/wiki/OnClientSoundStream "OnClientSoundStream"), this event only triggers for file streams, not for live ones since live streams never actually end.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The length of the stream in milliseconds

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the sound which just finished downloading.

events.name: onClientSoundStarted
events.description: This event is triggered when a **sound** is started.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason the sound was started, can be "play", "resumed" or "enabled".

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the sound's element.

events.name: onClientSoundStopped
events.description: This event is triggered when a **sound** is stopped.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason the sound was stopped, can be "finished", "paused", "destroyed" or "disabled".

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the sound's element.

events.name: onClientSoundStream
events.description: This event is triggered when a sound has just finished initial streaming. For file streams, this means the sound will now start playing, but isn't done downloading yet. For live streams, this just means the stream will start playing. This event will also trigger when, for some reason, the streaming failed.

parameters.name: success
parameters.description: A boolean indicating whether the stream was a success or not

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The length of the stream in seconds. Always returns 0 for a live stream

parameters.name: streamName
parameters.description: The name of the stream. Note that this isn't the filename. Also note that this isn't always provided

parameters.name: errorMessage
parameters.description: A string containing the error message or an empty string if there was no error

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the sound which either successfully streamed or failed to stream.

events.name: onClientTrailerAttach
events.description: This event is triggered by a trailer when it gets attached to a towing vehicle.

parameters.name: towedBy
parameters.description: the vehicle that is now towing the trailer.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the trailer that is now being towed.

events.name: onClientTrailerDetach
events.description: This event is triggered when a trailer gets detached from its towing vehicle.

parameters.name: towedBy
parameters.description: the vehicle that was towing the trailer.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the trailer that is now detached.

events.name: onClientTransferBoxProgressChange
events.description: This event is triggered every time the [resource](/wiki/Resource "Resource") file downloader (aka. transfer box) updates the download progress.

parameters.name: downloadedSizeTotal
parameters.description: The total progress in bytes.

parameters.name: downloadTotalBytes
parameters.description: The total size of the download in bytes.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the root element.

events.name: onClientTransferBoxVisibilityChange
events.description: This event is triggered every time the [resource](/wiki/Resource "Resource") file downloader (aka. transfer box) is shown or hidden by MTA.

parameters.name: isVisible
parameters.description: A boolean, indicating the new visibility status of the transfer box.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the root element.

events.name: onClientVehicleCollision
events.description: This event is triggered when a vehicle collides with an [element](/wiki/Element "Element") or a world object.

parameters.name: theHitElement
parameters.description: the other entity, or nil if the vehicle collided with the world

parameters.name: damageImpulseMag
parameters.description: the impact magnitude (Note: this is NOT the damage it is a force value which is then multiplied by the vehicles collision damage multiplier. for an example of this see below)

parameters.name: bodyPart
parameters.description:
the bodypart that hit the other element
0: Frame
2: Trunk
3: Hood
4: Rear
5: Front left door
6: Front right door
7: Rear left door
8: Rear right door
13: Front Left tyre
14: Front Right tyre
15: Back Left tyre
16: Back Right tyre

parameters.name: collisionX
parameters.description: the X coordinate of the position the collision took place

parameters.name: collisionY
parameters.description: the Y coordinate of the position the collision took place

parameters.name: collisionZ
parameters.description: the Z coordinate of the position the collision took place

parameters.name: normalX
parameters.description: the X coordinate of the surface normal of the hit object

parameters.name: normalY
parameters.description: the Y coordinate of the surface normal of the hit object

parameters.name: normalZ
parameters.description: the Z coordinate of the surface normal of the hit object

parameters.name: hitElementForce
parameters.description: 0 for non vehicles or the force of the other vehicle

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: model of the hit element (useful to detect building collisions as hitElement will be nil)

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle that collided with something.

events.name: onClientVehicleDamage
events.description: This event is triggered when a vehicle is damaged.

parameters.name: theAttacker
parameters.description: An element if there was an attacker.

parameters.name: theWeapon
parameters.description: An integer specifying the weapon ID if a weapon was used. Otherwise Damage Type ID is used.

parameters.name: loss
parameters.description: A float representing the amount of damage taken.

parameters.name: damagePosX
parameters.description: A float representing the X co-ordinate of where the damage took place.

parameters.name: damagePosY
parameters.description: A float representing the Y co-ordinate of where the damage took place.

parameters.name: damagePosZ
parameters.description: A float representing the Z co-ordinate of where the damage took place.

parameters.name: tireID
parameters.description: A number representing the tire which took damage, if there is one.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle that got damaged.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the vehicle health won't be reduced. Physical damage to the vehicle will remain.

events.name: onClientVehicleEnter
events.description: This event gets fired when a [player](/wiki/Player "Player") or [ped](/wiki/Ped "Ped") enters a vehicle.

parameters.name: thePed
parameters.description: the player or ped that entered the vehicle

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: the number of the seat that the ped is now sitting on. 0 = driver, higher numbers are passenger seats.

sourceElement.description: The source of the event is the vehicle that the ped entered.

events.name: onClientVehicleExit
events.description: This event gets fired when a [ped](/wiki/Ped "Ped") or [player](/wiki/Player "Player") gets out of a vehicle.

parameters.name: thePed
parameters.description: the player or ped element that exited the vehicle

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: the number of the seat that the player was sitting on. 0 = driver, higher numbers are passenger seats.

sourceElement.description: The source of the event is the vehicle that the ped exited.

events.name: onClientVehicleExplode
events.description: This event is triggered when a vehicle explodes.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle that exploded.

events.name: onClientVehicleNitroStateChange
events.description: This event gets triggered when nitro state is changing.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: current state of nitro

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player vehicle.

events.name: onClientVehicleRespawn
events.description: This event is triggered when a vehicle respawns.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle that respawned.

events.name: onClientVehicleStartEnter
events.description: This event is triggered when a [ped](/wiki/Ped "Ped") or [player](/wiki/Player "Player") starts entering a vehicle. Once the entering animation completes, [onClientVehicleEnter](/wiki/OnClientVehicleEnter "OnClientVehicleEnter") is triggered.

parameters.name: thePed
parameters.description: the ped that just started entering a vehicle.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: the number of the seat he is going to sit on.

parameters.name: door
parameters.description: An integer of which door the ped used (0-3). 0 is driver side door, 1 is front passenger, 2 is back left, 3 is back right.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle the ped is entering.

events.canceling: This event can be canceled, but only for the local player or peds synced by the client. If cancelled, they will not begin to the enter the vehicle.

events.name: onClientVehicleStartExit
events.description: This event is triggered when a [ped](/wiki/Ped "Ped") or [player](/wiki/Player "Player") starts exiting a vehicle. Once the exiting animation completes, [onClientVehicleExit](/wiki/OnClientVehicleExit "OnClientVehicleExit") is triggered.

parameters.name: thePed
parameters.description: the ped who started exiting the vehicle.

parameters.name: seat
parameters.description: the number of the seat that the ped was sitting on.

parameters.name: door
parameters.description: the number of the door that the ped is using to leave.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle that the ped started to exit.

events.name: onClientVehicleWeaponHit
events.description: This event is called when a vehicle weapon hits an element or the world.

parameters.name: weaponType
parameters.description: The type of vehicle weapon. (See the list below)

parameters.name: hitElement
parameters.description: The vehicle, ped or player that was hit by the weapon sometimes false.

parameters.name: hitX
parameters.description: The X world co-ordinate of where the hit occured.

parameters.name: hitY
parameters.description: The Y world co-ordinate of where the hit occured.

parameters.name: hitZ
parameters.description: The Z world co-ordinate of where the hit occured.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model ID of the element that was hit.

parameters.name: materialID
parameters.description: The material ID of the element that was hit.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the vehicle that fired the weapon.

events.name: onClientWeaponFire
events.description: This event triggers when a [custom weapon](/wiki/Element/Weapon "Element/Weapon") fires a shot.

parameters.name: hitElement
parameters.description: the element that was hit

parameters.name: posX
parameters.description: the position it will hit

parameters.name: posY
parameters.description: the position it will hit

parameters.name: posZ
parameters.description: the position it will hit

parameters.name: normalX
parameters.description: the normal it hit ( see processLineOfSight )

parameters.name: normalY
parameters.description: the normal it hit ( see processLineOfSight )

parameters.name: normalZ
parameters.description: the normal it hit ( see processLineOfSight )

parameters.name: materialType
parameters.description: the material type it hit ( see processLineOfSight )

parameters.name: lighting
parameters.description: the lighting of the entity it hit ( see processLineOfSight )

parameters.name: pieceHit
parameters.description: the piece of the entity it hit ( see processLineOfSight )

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the weapon that was fired.

events.canceling: If this event was canceled, then the weapon will not fire.

events.name: onClientWorldSound
events.description: This event triggers whenever a GTA sound starts playing.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: An integer representing the world sound group

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: An integer representing an individual sound within the group

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: a floating point number representing the X coordinate on the map.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: a floating point number representing the Y coordinate on the map.

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: a floating point number representing the Z coordinate on the map.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element, which emitted the sound.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the sound won't play at all.

events.name: onColShapeHit
events.description: This event is triggered when a physical [element](/wiki/Element "Element") hits a [colshape](/wiki/Colshape "Colshape").

parameters.name: hitElement
parameters.description: the element that entered the colshape.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: a boolean referring to whether the hit collision shape was in the same dimension as the element.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the colshape that got hit by a player or vehicle.

events.name: onColShapeLeave
events.description: This event is triggered when a player or a vehicle leaves a collision shape.

parameters.name: leaveElement
parameters.description: The element that who exited the col shape. This can be a player or a vehicle.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: a boolean referring to whether the collision shape was in the same dimension as the element.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the colshape that the element no longer is in contact with.

events.name: onConsole
events.description: This event is triggered when a player types a message into his console. It is also triggered when entering '/' commands via the chatbox.

parameters.name: theMessage
parameters.description: a string representing the message entered into the console.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player that entered the message in the console. This can be a player or the server console.

events.name: onDebugMessage
events.description: This event is triggered when debug messages (for instance errors or warnings) appear in the server console.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: the message which was outputted in the server console, without details like file, line etc.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description:
the type of debug message which was outputted.
0: "Custom" message.
1: Error message.
2: Warning message.
3: Information message.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description:
the file from which the debug message was outputted.
Note: may return nil when the source could not be found.

parameters.name: line
parameters.description:
the line in file file where the debug message was outputted.
Note: may return nil when the source could not be found.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: an int representing the amount of red color (0-255).

parameters.name: g
parameters.description: an int representing the amount of green color (0-255).

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: an int representing the amount of blue color (0-255).

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the root element.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the debug message won't appear.

events.name: onElementClicked
events.description: This event is triggered when an element is clicked on by the client. These events can only trigger when the client has its cursor enabled. It triggers for all three mousebuttons in both their up and down states.

parameters.name: mouseButton
parameters.description: a string representing the mouse button that was clicked. This might be left, middle or right.

parameters.name: buttonState
parameters.description: a string representing what state the button clicked is in. This might be up or down.

parameters.name: playerWhoClicked
parameters.description: the player that clicked on the element.

parameters.name: clickPosX
parameters.description: the X position in the world the player clicked at.

parameters.name: clickPosY
parameters.description: the Y position in the world the player clicked at.

parameters.name: clickPosZ
parameters.description: the Z position in the world the player clicked at.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that got clicked by the player.

events.name: onElementColShapeHit
events.description: This event is triggered when an player or vehicle element collides with a colshape.

parameters.name: theColShape
parameters.description: the colshape that this element collided with.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: a boolean representing if the element and the colshape are in the same dimension.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player or vehicle that collided with the colshape.

events.name: onElementColShapeLeave
events.description: This event is triggered when an player or vehicle element leaves the area of a [colshape](/wiki/Colshape "Colshape").

parameters.name: theColShape
parameters.description: the colshape that this element left the area of.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
parameters.description: a boolean representing if the element and the colshape are in the same dimension.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player or vehicle that left colshape.

events.name: onElementDataChange
events.description: This event is triggered *after* an element's [data](/wiki/Element_data "Element data") entry is changed. Such changes can be made on the client or the server using [setElementData](/wiki/SetElementData "SetElementData").

parameters.name: theKey
parameters.description: The name of the element data entry that has changed.

parameters.name: oldValue
parameters.description: The old value of this entry before it changed. See element data for a list of possible datatypes.

parameters.name: newValue
parameters.description: the new value of this entry after it changed. This will be equivalent to getElementData(source, theKey).

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element whose element data changed.

events.canceling: This event cannot be cancelled using cancelEvent. To reverse the effect, use setElementData with the old value. See Example.

events.name: onElementDestroy
events.description: This event is triggered when an element gets destroyed by [destroyElement](/wiki/DestroyElement "DestroyElement") or when the creator resource is stopping. It is also triggered when a parent element of this element is destroyed.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that is being destroyed.

events.name: onElementDimensionChange
events.description: This event is triggered when the dimension of an [element](/wiki/Element "Element") is changed using [setElementDimension](/wiki/SetElementDimension "SetElementDimension").

parameters.name: oldDimension
parameters.description: An int representing the dimension the element was in before.

parameters.name: newDimension
parameters.description: An int representing the dimension the element is in now.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that changed its dimension.

events.name: onElementInteriorChange
events.description: This event is triggered when the interior of an [element](/wiki/Element "Element") is changed using [setElementInterior](/wiki/SetElementInterior "SetElementInterior").

parameters.name: oldInterior
parameters.description: an int representing the interior the element was in before.

parameters.name: newInterior
parameters.description: an int representing the interior the element is in now.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that changed its interior.

events.name: onElementModelChange
events.description: This event is triggered when the model of an [element](/wiki/Element "Element") is changed using [setElementModel](/wiki/SetElementModel "SetElementModel").

parameters.name: oldModel
parameters.description: an int representing the model of the element before the change occurred.

parameters.name: newModel
parameters.description: an int representing the new model of the element.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that changed its model

events.canceling: This event does NOT support cancellation. Use setElementModel with the old value to reverse.

events.name: onElementStartSync
events.description: This event is triggered when an element becomes synced by a player.

parameters.name: newSyncer
parameters.description: a player element representing the player who is now syncing the element.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element that got synced by a player.

events.name: onElementStopSync
events.description: This event is triggered when an element is no longer synced by a player.

parameters.name: oldSyncer
parameters.description: a player element representing the last player who was syncing the element.

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the element which is no longer synced by a player.

events.name: onExplosion
events.description: This event is triggered every time an explosion is created either by server\-side [createExplosion](/wiki/CreateExplosion "CreateExplosion"), or when reported by [player](/wiki/Player "Player").

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X coordinate of where the explosion was created

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y coordinate of where the explosion was created

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: Z coordinate of where the explosion was created

parameters.name: theType
parameters.description: the type of explosion created, see: Explosion types

sourceElement.description: The source of this event is the player who notified server about explosion, or root if explosion was created server-side along without specifying creator in createExplosion.

events.canceling: If this event is canceled, the explosion will not occur.

events.name: onMarkerHit
events.description: This event is triggered when an element enters a marker created using [createMarker](/wiki/CreateMarker "CreateMarker").

parameters.name: hitElement
parameters.description: the element that hit the marker.

parameters.name: matchingDimension
